pages.name: Caro-Kann Defence:Classical Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 wrote castling as 0-0-0 and attacked along an h-file that is not open. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling in plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Classical Variation, Flohr Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 had the f4-knight pressing a d5-pawn that isn't there; plan 2 neutralised a knight not yet on f4; plan 3 wrote h4-h5 as one route. Rewrote plans 1-3; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Caro-Kann Defense: Martian Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked along an open f-file after ...fxe6 (White's f2-pawn closes it for White); plan 2 had Black play ...e6 when the f-pawn already recaptured there. Rewrote plans 1-3 around Bd3, Qxd3 and the g6 check; British spelling in plan 4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 5.Nc5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had White controlling d7 (no piece can reach it). Rewrote plan 1 around the b7 attack and the knight's retreat; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 5.Nc5 b6
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...c5 into White's c5-knight; plan 4 developed the light-squared bishop to d7 or e6 when it already stands on f5; plan 3 was vague. Rewrote plans 2-4; British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 5.Ng3
pages.notes: Plan 1 attacked a Bg6 not yet on g6 and aimed at Black's king. Rewrote plan 1; British spelling in plans 2 and 4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 6.Bc4 e6 7.N1e2 Nf6
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 described an f4-f5 pawn storm; plan 3 rerouted the g3-knight to f1 to clear a g-file that isn't open; plan 4 sent a knight via d7-f8-g6, where Black's bishop stands. Rewrote overview and plans 1, 3, 4; British spelling in plan 2.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 6.h4 h6 7.f4
pages.notes: Plan 1 pushed g4-g5 through the g3-knight; plan 2 missed that ...e6 meets f5. Rewrote plans 1-2.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 6.h4 h6 7.Nh3
pages.notes: Plan 2 rerouted a knight via d7 to f8, where the bishop stands. Rewrote plan 2; British spelling in plans 1 and 4.

pages.name: Caro-Kann: Classical, 6.N1e2
pages.notes: Overview and plan 1 had White preparing f2-f4 and playing Nf3 (no knight can reach f3); plan 3 was vague. Rewrote overview and plans 1 and 3.
